item.title: Can Diabetes Be Reversed? Experts Say Remission, Not Cure, Is the Real Goal
item.description: Experts say “diabetes reversal” is misleading, as type 2 diabetes is not cured but can enter remission. Achieving normal blood sugar without medication is possible, especially with early diagnosis, weight loss, and lifestyle changes. However, remission requires ongoing monitoring since blood sugar can rise again due to ageing, weight gain, or illness.
